Re:	PUC Project No. 59142, Review of ERCOT’s Interconnection Processes for Large Loads – ERCOT Updates: Good Cause Exceptions for PGRR 145, Batch Zero Verification and Audit Process, and Community Impact Review Process
Dear Chairman and Commissioners: 
	Electric Reliability Council of Texas, Inc. (ERCOT) submits the attached presentation for filing in this project.  ERCOT intends to discuss the information in this presentation at the Commission’s August 20, 2026 open meeting and will be pleased to answer any questions the Commissioners may have. 
Respectfully,

 /s/ Chad V. Seely		
Chad V. Seely
SVP, Regulatory Policy, General Counsel, and Chief Compliance Officer
chad.seely@ercot.com

           methodology
